title: 70 Scrub Oak Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 70 Scrub Oak Circle is a 5.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 70 Scrub Oak Circle, an elegant five-bedroom retreat on a spacious corner lot in WaterColor’s Lake District. This luxurious home blends refined craftsmanship with coastal charm and offers a private pool, carriage house, six-passenger electric cart, and six adult bikes for exploring 30A with ease.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 14 Passes Included 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included Parking for 2 Vehicles Green Egg Grill and Propane Grill Built-In Ice Maker Exterior Shower Private Pool (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1 through May 1) Large Outside Balcony and Porches Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Lake District Short Bike Ride to WaterColor’s Frog Pool 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club via Western Lake Bridge 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Thoughtfully designed and beautifully detailed, 70 Scrub Oak Circle offers an inviting escape for families and groups seeking comfort and connection. The home’s open layout is enhanced by natural light, shiplap walls, and exposed beams that highlight its timeless coastal architecture. The chef’s kitchen serves as the heart of the home and features hand-selected granite countertops, a Thermador range with double ovens, and an oversized island that is ideal for meal preparation and conversation. Adjacent to the kitchen, the living and dining areas flow seamlessly together to create a welcoming space for relaxation and shared time. The first floor also includes a queen guest suite with a private bath, a convenient half bath, and a well-equipped laundry room. On the second floor, the primary suite provides a peaceful retreat with a king bed, soaking tub, and access to a spacious balcony that overlooks the property. Two additional bedrooms include a king guest room and a bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks and a trundle. Each bedroom has its own private bathroom, and an additional full bath with a shower and tub combination adds convenience for larger groups. The carriage house offers added privacy and flexibility with a queen bedroom, private bath, full kitchen, and living space with a queen sleeper sofa. It is perfect for extended family or additional guests. The outdoor living area completes this exceptional property with a private heated pool, covered grilling station, and brick patio surrounded by lush landscaping. Whether enjoying a swim, dining outdoors, or relaxing on the balcony, this Lake District retreat offers the perfect setting for leisure and gathering. With six adult bikes and a six-passenger electric cart included, exploring Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and the Beach Club is simple and enjoyable.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Kitchen Living Room Half Bathroom Laundry Room Second Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Beds with Trundle (Sleeps 5), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Additional Full Bathroom with Shower and Tub Combination Carriage House Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Combination Full Kitchen Living Space with Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) Life in WaterColor Located in the desirable Lake District, 70 Scrub Oak Circle offers quick access to community pools, Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, and the scenic Western Lake Bridge. Guests can ride bikes to Seaside, enjoy dining and boutique shopping, or explore the trails and parks that define WaterColor’s charm. With its corner location, private pool, and luxury amenities, this home delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and convenience.
